rule.note: Signals need P(target before stop) at or above the break-even hit rate and expectancy above +0.10R after costs. The portfolio takes the five best edges across the universe, one position per instrument, 1% of equity risked each.

assumptions.exit: barrier price when touched, the open when a bar gaps through it, else the close after the 15-bar horizon
assumptions.note: Gate statistics count every qualifying signal, including overlapping ones. The portfolio simulation holds at most five positions at once and applies 1% of current equity as risk per trade.

information.note: Rank IC is the daily Spearman correlation between the model edge ranking and realised directional return. Above roughly 0.03 with a stable sign, the ranking carries usable information.

buyAndHoldSPY.source: SPY split-adjusted closes, price return only (no dividends)
